theorems.name: Submission.dorag_gc_decay_plane_eq_approxTangent
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U W : Set (Euclid P)) (R : IMRep U n) (κ : ℝ), IsOpen W → W ⊆ U → AEStronglyMeasurable (fun x => (approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x).starProjection) R.measure → (∀ y ∈ R.measure.support, ∀ t : ℝ, 0 < t → closedBall y t ⊆ W → unitBallVolume n ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.exp (κ * t) / t ^ n) * R.measure (closedBall y t)) → ∀ᵐ x ∂R.measure, x ∈ W → ∀ (S : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (s₀ K : ℝ), 0 < s₀ → (∀ s : ℝ, 0 < s → s ≤ s₀ → ∫⁻ y in closedBall x s, ENNReal.ofReal (∑ i : Fin P, ‖(approxTangentPlane n R.carrier y).starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ)) - S.starProjection (EuclideanSpace.single i (1 : ℝ))‖ ^ 2) ∂R.measure ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (K * s ^ (n + 1))) → S = approxTangentPlane n R.carrier x
